panels.title: Chain height

defaults.noValue: no chain node is scraped

panels.description: Highest block any scraped chain node reports.

panels.title: Block time

defaults.noValue: no block-interval histogram in the window

panels.description: Median interval between blocks over ten minutes.

panels.title: Transactions per second

defaults.noValue: no transaction counter scraped

panels.description: Committed transactions per second. Every node counts the same transactions, so this is the highest node rate, not a sum.

panels.title: Validators

defaults.noValue: no chain node is scraped

panels.description: Size of the active validator set as the chain reports it. It changes with the epoch, so read the sparkline too.

panels.title: Nodes online

defaults.noValue: no chain target is configured

panels.description: Chain nodes of the monitoring inventory that answered their last scrape. A validator outside the inventory is not counted.

panels.title: Nodes behind
panels.description: Chain nodes more than three blocks behind the highest scraped node.

panels.title: P2P peers

defaults.noValue: no node reported a peer count

panels.description: Peer connections summed over scraped chain nodes.

panels.title: Stalest chain sample

defaults.noValue: no chain sample in the lookback window

panels.description: Age of the oldest chain sample across scraped nodes. One node falling silent raises it.

panels.title: Chain nodes
panels.description: One row per chain node: scrape state, lag behind the highest node, peers, current consensus round, mempool, validator power and missed blocks as the node itself reports them, P2P traffic and the running chain version.

panels.title: Blocks behind

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: How far each chain node is behind the highest scraped node.

panels.title: Block interval

defaults.noValue: no block-interval histogram in the window

panels.description: Median and 95th percentile interval between blocks over ten minutes.

panels.title: Round duration p95

defaults.noValue: no round-duration histogram in the window

panels.description: 95th percentile of consensus round duration. A long round means slow proposals or votes.

panels.title: Consensus rounds

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Round of the current height. Above zero, the first proposal did not commit.

panels.title: Voting power signed

defaults.noValue: no consensus round sampled in the window

panels.description: Share of voting power seen in precommit, peak of each minute. The dashed line at two thirds is the floor below which a round cannot commit.

panels.title: Missing validators

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Validators absent from the last commit, as each node saw it.

panels.title: Missed blocks by validator

defaults.noValue: no validator exports a missed-block counter

panels.description: Blocks the validator of the node missed. A host without its own validator exports nothing.

panels.title: Late votes

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Votes per second that arrived after their step ended. A rise on one node points at its network or clock.

panels.title: Block processing p95

defaults.noValue: no block-processing histogram in the window

panels.description: 95th percentile time to apply a block per node.

panels.title: Transactions per second

defaults.noValue: no transaction counter scraped

panels.description: Committed transactions per second, the highest node rate.

panels.title: Mempool

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Transactions waiting in the mempool of each node.

panels.title: Failed mempool transactions

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Transactions per second each node rejected at mempool check.

panels.title: P2P peers

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Peer connections per chain node.

panels.title: P2P received

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Bytes per second each node receives from its peers.

panels.title: P2P sent

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: Bytes per second each node sends to its peers.

panels.title: CPU busy

defaults.noValue: no host matches the filter

panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle, averaged over cores.

panels.title: Memory used

defaults.noValue: no host matches the filter

panels.description: Memory in use, excluding reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Operational disk free

defaults.noValue: no host matches the filter

panels.description: Free space on the fullest real volume of each host. The dashed lines are the 15% and 8% disk alert levels.

panels.title: Software inventory

defaults.noValue: no host matching the filter has reported its software inventory

panels.description: Component versions each host reports.

panels.title: Hosts reporting

defaults.noValue: no host target is configured

panels.description: Hosts whose node-exporter answered its last scrape.

panels.title: Targets down

defaults.noValue: no target is configured

panels.description: Scrape targets that failed their last attempt, across every job.

panels.title: Validators beyond the monitored set

defaults.noValue: no validator count sampled

panels.description: Validators in the set minus the chain targets this deployment scrapes: how many validators the lab cannot see.

panels.title: Stalest collector file

defaults.noValue: no collector file is exported

panels.description: Age of the oldest textfile a collector wrote. A frozen file keeps looking fresh unless this is watched.

panels.title: Targets down by job

defaults.noValue: no target is configured

panels.description: Failing targets per scrape job. A job at zero is answering.

panels.title: Collector freshness

defaults.noValue: no collector file is exported

panels.description: Seconds since each textfile was last written.
